name: Halo
description: An editorial template for hair salons, day spas and beauty studios — rose-porcelain canvas, merlot accent, Bodoni headlines, arched mirror-shaped photography, a scrolling hours ticker, and a signature treatment menu whose photo changes as you move through Hair, Colour, Skin, Nails and Body.

variants.arch: Centered headline over one wide arched photo of the studio

default_variant_description: Type-led hero beside three arched photos of the work
